newsitem.title: UK: ICI, exporters down on sterling strength.
newsitem.headline: ICI, exporters down on sterling strength.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc and other major international stocks fell on Friday as sterling rose to a 33-month high of 2.5865 against the mark and climbed against the dollar, dealers and analysts said.
ICI shares dropped 9p to 771p by 1446 GMT while British Steel was down 3p at 166-1/4 and BOC Group Plc fell 4-1/2p to 885.

One chemical analyst said the continued strength of the pound would have a negative impact on the earnings of ICI and other leading chemical companies. "Sterling's strength could decimate the sector," he said.
Sterling remained strong against the mark and dollar in afternoon trading at 2.5815 marks and 1.6810 dollars respectively.
Among other major export stocks, Guinness Plc was down 5p at 445-1/2 and TI Group was down 7-1/2p at 554-1/2.
